claim: Multicalibration (calibration across intersecting groups) with prompt-embedding clustering or LLM self-annotation groups yields better-calibrated correctness probabilities than marginal calibration; IGLB and GCULR beat histogram binning and Platt scaling on QA.
stance_target: L1: group-conditional calibration for LLM confidence (QA, not code); methodological ancestor of arXiv 2512.08810
scope_conditions: QA datasets, several LLMs incl. Mistral-7B-v0.1 (appendix), ICML 2024
quoted_support: Multicalibration asks for calibration not just marginally, but simultaneously across various intersecting groupings of the data.

breadth.confidence_families: logit/probability and self-annotated features calibrated by multicalibration
